description: High Hazard Zones Viewer App is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CAL FIRE. From 2012-2015 California faced the worst epidemic of tree mortality in modern history. Multiple years of drought, combined with an infestation of native bark beetles, contributed to the death of millions of trees on federal, state, and private lands across California. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher CAL FIRE. Its tags are CAL FIRE, Drought, Tree Mortality, cal fire. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
